audit.whatIsWrong: The content-layer whys[] claim Warwick wins Levels 1, 3 and 4-5 and that Galio wins outright at 2+ items, while win[] and phases[].side already read Skill/Galio/Galio/Galio/Galio/Galio/Skill. The page rendered two answers per row.
audit.why: The mirror audit (galio__warwick) fixed the chart to Skill, Galio x5, Skill with Galio FAV 4/10 — inverse of Warwick's 6/10. The sides are already correct on both layers; only the prose contradicted them.
audit.corrected: Rewrote whys[0..4] and whys[6] to agree with the existing sides. No side or rating flips proposed, so no atomic chart group is needed.

audit.whatIsWrong: Spikes framed Level 6 as a Warwick window and never named the cooldowns that decide it.
audit.why: Justice Punch is 11/10/9/8/7s and Hero's Entrance is 180/160/140s; Primal Howl is 15/14/13/12/11s. The spikes are cooldown windows, not level numbers.
audit.corrected: Spike text now keys to Justice Punch's cooldown and to Blade of the Ruined King as the answer to his magic-resist stacking.

audit.whatIsWrong: Primal Howl (E) was absent from the content layer entirely, and Eternal Hunger's damage type was never connected to Shield of Durand.
audit.why: Infinite Duress is flagged channel: interruptible — Justice Punch's knockup is Galio's only answer to it. Primal Howl's 1-second fear is cast-inhibiting, so it denies the Shield of Durand charge. Eternal Hunger is bonus magic damage on every auto, and Shield of Durand reduces magic at double the rate it reduces physical, which is why %HP physical from Blade of the Ruined King is the way through.
audit.corrected: mid, late, spikes[1], spikes[3], phases[4].why and wants[] now state the Primal Howl / Justice Punch / Infinite Duress sequence and the magic-vs-physical reduction split.

audit.why: suspectNames flagged "Shield of Durand's" as a near-miss; it is the correct name with a possessive. No name error.

edits.before: Level 1 is yours — Galio's poke-based kit can't stop your Blood Hunt dive and Q shove.
edits.after: Level 1 is skill — Eternal Hunger sustains you but Colossal Smash out-ranges every trade.

edits.before: Level 2 is skill, hinging on dodging his Winds of War tornado overlap.
edits.after: Level 2 is Galio's — Justice Punch (E) knocks you up before you reach him.

edits.before: Level 3 favours you as you dash past Q and win the melee trade.
edits.after: Level 3 is Galio's — Shield of Durand cuts the magic on your autos.

edits.before: Levels 4-5 stay yours — his anti-poke kit is weak to your sustained dive.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 stay Galio's — Justice Punch is up every 9s and yours is not.

edits.before: Level 5-6 is even: his W channel and E knockup can now interrupt your all-in.
edits.after: Level 6 is Galio's — Justice Punch cancels the Infinite Duress channel outright.

edits.before: With 2+ items Galio wins — resist stacking and Duress interrupts beat your dive.
edits.after: With 2+ items it evens out — Blade of the Ruined King bites through his resists.

edits.before: Level 1-2 you win — Galio's early damage lives on Winds of War (Q) poke, not melee, so Blood Hunt in and use Q heal to shove him off the wave. Sidestep the tornado overlap zone where his Q doubles up.
edits.after: Level 1-2 is close but never free — Winds of War (Q) is 11s at rank 1, so step off the point where the two windblasts converge and take the wave instead. Jaws of the Beast costs 80 mana a bite; do not chase him with it.

edits.before: Levels 3-6 favour you: dash past his Q with Blood Hunt and Jaws-heal through his soft melee trade. At 6 be careful — his Justice Punch (E) knockup and Shield of Durand (W) channel can cancel your Infinite Duress, so bait E out before committing your ult.
edits.after: Levels 3-6 belong to Galio: Eternal Hunger is magic damage on every auto and Shield of Durand cuts magic at double the rate it cuts physical, so your autos stop paying. Primal Howl (E, 15s) is the trade-flipper — hold it for his Justice Punch, then Jaws in while E is down.

edits.before: From first item Galio tips ahead and by two items he wins — Shield of Durand's damage reduction halves your DoT, his E knocks you out of Duress, and stacked magic resist means your trades barely register. He also roams with his global R, so close the lane out early before his anti-dive tools come online.
edits.after: From first item Galio tips ahead, and Blade of the Ruined King is what pulls you level again — Shield of Durand blunts magic hardest, so %HP physical damage is your way through his resists. His Justice Punch still knocks you out of Infinite Duress, so open with Primal Howl and ult only once that E is spent.

edits.before: Even at 6 your Duress can lock him, but his Shield of Durand (W) magic-resist channel and Justice Punch (E) knockup can interrupt your ult — bait E before you commit so R lands clean.
edits.after: Justice Punch (E) is his only answer to Infinite Duress, and Primal Howl fears him out of a Shield of Durand charge — howl first, make him spend the punch, then ult inside the 9-second window while his E is down.

edits.before: Full-build Galio is a resist-stacked anti-diver — W halves your DoT, E knocks you out of Duress, and his global R gives him tempo you can't match; win before he itemizes.
edits.after: Full-build Galio is an anti-diver — Shield of Durand blunts magic worst, E knocks you out of Duress, and Hero's Entrance (140s) gives him map tempo; win before he itemizes.

edits.before: Dodge Winds of War (Q) overlap then dash with Blood Hunt
edits.after: Dodge the Winds of War (Q) converge point, then Jaws in

edits.before: Force melee trades where his anti-poke kit is weakest
edits.after: Hold Primal Howl (E) for his Justice Punch commit

edits.before: Stack magic resist so W and passive shrug off your DoT
edits.after: Stack MR so Shield of Durand blanks Eternal Hunger

edits.before: W attack speed turns on against low-HP targets. Only take the trade when Galio's Justice Punch is down.
edits.after: Blood Hunt only turns on below 50% health, so level 2 gives you nothing while Justice Punch (11s) is up.

edits.before: Infinite Duress is a point-and-click fight starter that locks his carry tool. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Galio's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Infinite Duress suppresses for 1.5s but it is a channel — Justice Punch knocks you out of it. Fear him with Primal Howl first, then ult into the empty E.

notes: Chart sides already matched the mirror on both layers; only the whys[] prose disagreed, so no side/rating flips were proposed and no atomic chart group is required. packet.levelChart in the audit packet is stale (gives Warwick 4/7) — it disagrees with both the live data and the mirror; the live layers are correct. suspectNames flagged 'Shield of Durand's' as a wrong name — it is correct with a possessive, false positive.
